title: Today's top defense-tech headlines
big: 26 new stories since the last brief. The busiest areas: allies & theaters and drones & air autonomy.

stories.h: US greenlights 500 Patriot missiles for Ukraine, with $2.1 billion to be paid by allies
stories.what: The announcement comes amid heightened tensions between Kyiv and Washington, including purported delays in the transfer of interceptors.
stories.you: Missile defense is one of the biggest budget lines this decade, and its software and sensors are open to newcomers.

stories.h: Stealthy GJ-21 Drone Has Launched And Recovered From Type 076 Amphibious Assault Ship, China Claims
stories.what: Signs that the PLAN has been building up to this significant milestone in naval airpower have been growing for more than a year.
stories.you: Drones are becoming the military's default purchase, so volume, price and reliability decide who wins.

stories.h: Satellite photos confirm Ukraine destroyed two Russian Su-34s
stories.what: Satellite imagery shows the wreckage of two Su-34 fighter-bombers destroyed at Russia’s Marinovka air base in the Volgograd region, confirming Ukraine’s claim that its Neptune cruise missiles knocked out the jets on Oct. 29, open-source analysts said.
stories.you: More of the military's sensing and communications now runs through orbit, and new suppliers are getting in.

stories.h: U.S. Navy orders $114.7M power upgrade for H-1 helicopters
stories.what: The U.S. Navy has ordered $114.7 million in structural and electrical upgrade hardware for the U.S. Marine Corps’ AH-1Z Viper attack and UH-1Y Venom utility helicopters, exercising an option on Bell Textron’s contract for the third phase of the program.
stories.you: The Navy is short of ships and is turning to cheaper unmanned boats, which opens the door to new builders.

stories.h: Pentagon reveals FY26 intelligence budget at $30.9 billion
stories.what: Meanwhile, the National Intelligence Program budget was revealed at $78.1 billion.
stories.you: Budget and policy moves decide which programs get real money and when; they're the earliest signal of demand.

watch.why: Around November 3. Whether US commercial growth keeps outpacing government revenue.

idea.why: Tracks inventory, firmware, battery health, losses and operator training for thousands of drones from many vendors. Drone Dominance buys from 11+ vendors and nobody manages the mixed fleet. At 200k units, logistics is the bottleneck.
